cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Rank Everything
cards.instruction: Turn every new contribution into a ranking that places you nearer the top.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. I planned this picnic, so I get first choice of cake. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Destination selection outranks transport. You can go second.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I baked it. The baker gets the big end piece.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Baking outranks driving. But I commissioned the cake, so commissioning goes first. I'll take the end piece.
